article: Microsoft Wordのショートカット一覧
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Compared all 22 shortcut-key rows, translated action labels, dates, descriptions, scope statements, and outbound Microsoft Support references. Verified that every locale has the same ordered shortcut key list.
findings: Removed the duplicate future 2026-09-24 date, retained the original 2024-04-07 publication date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24 in all editions.
Clarified in all editions that the table covers Word for Windows with a U.S. keyboard layout; macOS and other layouts may differ.
Verified the 22 shortcut combinations and translated action labels against Microsoft's current official Word keyboard-shortcuts article.
Removed duplicate lastmod front-matter keys from index.md; refreshed source/translation hashes to match these metadata-only revisions and set publication verification pending.

post/Microsoft Wordのショートカット一覧/index.ar.m.source: post/Microsoft Wordのショートカット一覧/index.md
post/Microsoft Wordのショートカット一覧/index.ar.m.summary: Compared the complete translation with the Japanese source, including all 22 shortcut keys, their descriptions, scope, and the official reference.

meaning.note: The translated table preserves the same 22 shortcuts and their described Word actions; the Windows and U.S. keyboard-layout scope is stated explicitly.

terminology.note: Ctrl, Shift, Home, End, and F12 key names are preserved; formatting, editing, and document-navigation labels match the source.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims.

code.note: The article contains no executable code.

links.note: The localized Microsoft Support link resolves to Microsoft's current Word keyboard-shortcuts article.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
Shortcuts can vary by Word version, platform, and keyboard layout; the table is explicitly scoped to Windows and a U.S. layout.
